exposure_reservation.conservative_components_note: Related by unresolved candidate links; disclose in any later use

limitations: Exploratory decision diagnostic only: not a pilot, holdout, clean or independent evaluation, nor a confirmatory benchmark.
All TRAIN images were processed by the historical Qwen2.5 P2 full-pool run (aggregate exposure); the diagnostic was motivated after observing P2 aggregates, including TEST.
Unresolved near-duplicate/source-family candidate links are recorded, not adjudicated; conservative components do not prove or disprove independence.
No complete per-sample exposure ledger exists; absence of a record is not evidence of non-exposure.
Metallurgy has few TRAIN Anomaly images and folder/text domain conflicts; descriptive only.
TEST relationships come only from the W1 audit; no TEST file was opened to build this cohort.
Ground truth is the original folder label; it is benchmark annotation, not verified real-world hazard.

rule.dependency: At most one image per mandatory group across the cohort: transitive TRAIN exact-byte duplicates, Normal point IDs and same-point-folder sequence pairs (cohort.candidate_groups)
rule.domain: Original folder domain (DEC-W2-D3-003); text-domain conflicts flagged, never reassigned
rule.exclusions: TRAIN IDs in W1 confirmed cross-split exact-byte pairs with TEST
rule.inference_order: ascending SHA-256(seed + '|order|' + sample_id), so a partial run is not domain-ordered
rule.level03_floor: Anomaly stratum first takes up to min(2, quota) eligible Level03 by rank, then fills the quota from all remaining eligible Anomaly by rank
rule.ranking: ascending SHA-256(seed + '|' + sample_id) hex digest, sample_id tie-break
rule.recorded_not_excluded: Unresolved near-duplicate/source-family candidate links, prior aggregate/per-sample exposure and folder/text domain conflicts
rule.shortage: STOP with exact shortages and no selected IDs; no redistribution, lower N, new seed or relaxed rule
rule.universe: W1 historical TRAIN inventory (duplicate_leakage_audit samples split=train), folder domain/level cross-checked with dataset_validation; TEST metadata only from W1 audit
